name: Barnford Park Playground
text: A children's play area in Barnford Park, Oldbury, with a games area, skate park, multi-use games area and community pavilion.

name: Britannia Park Playground
text: A new play area, opened in August 2024 with a skate park, in Britannia Park, Rowley Regis.

name: Haden Hill Park Playground
text: Playgrounds in Haden Hill Park, Cradley Heath, with pools, a bowling green, walks, a nature reserve, a Victorian mansion and a Tudor hall.

name: Lightwoods Park Playground
text: A children's play area in Lightwoods Park, Smethwick, with a skate park, Shakespeare Gardens, a bandstand and Lightwoods House.

name: Victoria Park Smethwick Playground
text: Children's play areas in Victoria Park, Smethwick, with a tennis court, cycle routes and a bandstand.

name: Victoria Park Tipton Playground
text: Children's play areas in Victoria Park, Tipton, with a skate park, tennis courts and walking routes.

name: Brunswick Park Playground
text: A children's play area in Brunswick Park, Wednesbury, with an outdoor gym, skate park, multi-use games area and tennis courts.

name: Dartmouth Park Playground
text: A large play area in Dartmouth Park, West Bromwich, a Grade II listed park with lakes, between the town centre and Sandwell Valley Country Park.

name: Forge Mill Farm Play Area
text: A play area by the entrance to Forge Mill Farm, the council's farm in Sandwell Valley Country Park.
